# x-look

> Chrome extension that turns x.com into a quiet, work-friendly reading list

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/x-look): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.
- [Website](https://xlook.cocode.dk): Official website and documentation.
